_doc: Criteria for the fiction world. Mirrors the real-world set where it still makes sense, drops what doesn't (visas, halal certification, wheelchair access to Mordor), and adds the dimensions that actually matter when the destination is imaginary — magic, danger, technology, and whether you can get home again.
